Q-1282: What day of the week was 2025-09-17?
Answer: Wednesday

Reasoning: 2025-01-01 is a Wednesday. Days from Jan 1 to Sep 17: Jan(31)+Feb(28)+Mar(31)+Apr(30)+May(31)+Jun(30)+Jul(31)+Aug(31)+17 = 260 days elapsed after Jan 1. 260 mod 7 = 1. Wednesday + 1 = Thursday? Let me recompute: Sep 17 is the 260th day of the year (2025 is not a leap year). Day 1 = Jan 1 = Wednesday. (260-1) mod 7 = 259 mod 7 = 59*7=413... 259/7=37*7=259. So 259 mod 7 = 0. Day 260 is same weekday as day 1 = Wednesday.
Answer: Wednesday
